queries.name: dex_inventory
queries.sql: SELECT f.source_path, f.string_count, f.method_count, f.class_count FROM dex_files f ORDER BY f.file_id

queries.name: dup_class_defs
queries.sql: SELECT descriptor, COUNT(*) AS defs FROM classes GROUP BY descriptor HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY defs DESC, descriptor LIMIT 30

queries.name: string_exception_text
queries.sql: SELECT s.string_idx, s.value FROM strings s WHERE s.value LIKE '%was aborted%' OR s.value LIKE '%on a null object%' ORDER BY s.string_idx LIMIT 40

queries.name: string_class_descriptor
queries.sql: SELECT s.string_idx, s.value FROM strings s WHERE s.value LIKE 'Landroidx/fragment/app/%' ORDER BY s.string_idx LIMIT 40

queries.name: callers_of_method
queries.sql: SELECT method_class, method_name, callee_class, callee_name FROM method_calls WHERE callee_name = 'postDelayed' ORDER BY method_class LIMIT 40

queries.name: two_hop_chain
queries.sql: WITH c1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT callee_class, callee_name FROM method_calls WHERE callee_name = 'postDelayed'), c2 AS (SELECT c.method_class, c.method_name, c.callee_class, c.callee_name FROM method_calls c JOIN c1 ON c.callee_class = c1.callee_class AND c.callee_name = c1.callee_name) SELECT c2.method_class, c2.method_name, c2.callee_class, c2.callee_name FROM method_calls c3 JOIN c2 ON c3.callee_class = c2.method_class AND c3.callee_name = c2.method_name LIMIT 30

queries.name: field_accesses_in_method
queries.sql: SELECT f.using_type, f.field_class, f.field_name, f.field_type FROM method_field_accesses f WHERE f.method_class = 'Ljwtc/android/chess/start;' ORDER BY f.field_name LIMIT 60

queries.name: try_catch_ranges
queries.sql: SELECT t.method_idx, t.start_addr, t.insn_count, h.type_idx, h.addr, h.is_catch_all FROM try_items t JOIN catch_handlers h ON h.method_idx = t.method_idx AND h.handler_off = t.handler_off ORDER BY t.method_idx, t.start_addr LIMIT 40

queries.name: reflection_callsites
queries.sql: SELECT method_class, method_name, callee_class, callee_name FROM method_calls WHERE callee_name IN ('forName','getDeclaredMethod','getDeclaredField','getMethod') ORDER BY method_class LIMIT 40

queries.name: activity_entry_chain
queries.sql: SELECT c.method_class, c.method_name, c.callee_class, c.callee_name FROM method_calls c WHERE c.method_class LIKE '%/start;' AND (c.callee_name = 'setContentView' OR c.callee_name = 'onCreate' OR c.callee_name = 'postDelayed') LIMIT 30

queries.name: canvas_overloads
queries.sql: SELECT method_class, method_name, callee_class, callee_name FROM method_calls WHERE callee_class = 'Landroid/graphics/Canvas;' AND (callee_name LIKE 'draw%' OR callee_name = 'clipPath') ORDER BY method_class LIMIT 60

queries.name: missing_callee_classes
queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.callee_class FROM method_calls c WHERE c.callee_class LIKE 'Ljwtc/%' AND c.callee_class NOT IN (SELECT descriptor FROM classes) ORDER BY c.callee_class LIMIT 40

queries.name: manifest_components
queries.note: DexSQL schema is DEX-only; no manifest/resource table exists (verified via `dexsql tables`). Baseline tool covers this category.
